data.name: Kadhar
data.long_meaning: Kadhar is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kadru', which means 'mountain' or 'strength'. In Hindu mythology, Kadru is the name of a serpent queen who gave birth to the Nagas, the divine serpents. Kadhar is a name that signifies strength, power, and bravery. It is a unisex name that is suitable for both boys and girls.

In many regions of India, it is common for people to name their children after mythological figures, and the name Kadhar is one such option that resonates with the country's rich heritage and folklore.

It reminds us of the unwavering power of the mountains, which endure the test of time and weather. Likewise, the name inspires us to tap into our own inner strength and bravery, to face challenges with determination and resilience. The name also has ties to the divine serpents in Hindu mythology, reminding us of the cycle of life and the interconnectedness of all beings in the universe. Ultimately, the name Kadhar serves as a reminder of the inner strength and power that each of us possesses, and the spiritual journey of living in accordance with that power.
